final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and expressly conceded the key missing predicates: no evidence of resolution, no evidence of completed disclosure, and no evidence of approved risk acceptance. The response is a narrower interpretation of the same record, not new proof. That narrowing matters analytically because it abandons any claim of unconditional compliance, but it is still insufficient for compliant_with_caveats: under the policy, caveating a certification record is not itself a substitute for resolving, disclosing, or obtaining approved risk acceptance for a material limitation affecting a named launch use case. Since the named HR benefits enrollment gap remains unresolved and legal review is still open, the compliance condition remains unmet.
remaining_concerns: The HR benefits enrollment weakness remains material under policy because it affects a named customer-commitment segment.
The release policy still requires the material limitation to be resolved, disclosed before launch, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
There is still no admissible evidence that the limitation has been resolved.
There is still no admissible evidence of approved risk acceptance.
Legal review on required disclosure remains open, so the disclosure predicate is unresolved.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents do not satisfy the separate policy-required material-disclosure or risk-acceptance condition.
Public guidance about documenting and managing AI risk does not override the internal release policy threshold.
